structured_output.answer: This is a product decision: the exact wording of the gift note. The project owner has to pick one of the two strings, and the spec has to drop the other scenario. Suggestion: keep "Thank you for your gift order." and delete the "Gift note wishes the receiver well" scenario. The text is printed on the buyer's receipt, and the proposal calls it "the line a receipt prints for a gift order", which fits a message to the buyer. Nothing in the repository settles which one is meant.
structured_output.rationale: Both scenarios in specs/receipt-gift/spec.md (lines 11-17) have the same WHEN and require different exact return strings, so no implementation can satisfy both. The requirement (line 9) only says the function returns the gift note as a str. The proposal only says it is "the line a receipt prints for a gift order", and no other spec or code mentions gift notes. Picking the customer-facing wording is a copy/UX decision for the project owner. The suggested string is a guess based on who the receipt is for, not something the repository shows.
